transactions_description: Review Safe transaction proposals, such as payouts and owner changes, and their approval status
transactions_empty_description: Once you create a payout, its approval status appears here
transactions_section_signatures_descript: Once {required} signatures from the headquarters Safe owners are collected, the relayer account submits it

transactions_wallet_alert_title: Approvals are signed in the wallet
transactions_wallet_alert_description: Headquarters Owners and Approvers sign with their passkeys in the wallet. This screen only shows the approval status.
transactions_reject_confirm_description: This cannot be undone, and the proposal can no longer be executed.
transactions_reject_later_warning: There are {count} unsent proposals on this Safe with a later nonce. If you reject this one, they cannot run until the next new proposal fills the freed nonce. Their signatures stay valid.

transactions_error_not_open: Only unsubmitted proposals can be rejected
transactions_error_reject_forbidden: Only the proposal's creator or a headquarters Owner can reject it
transactions_new_description: Headquarters Owners and Approvers approve the payout by signing it in the wallet
transactions_balance_unavailable: Could not read the balance. A payout above the balance will fail when executed.
transactions_no_safe_groups_description: Payouts can be made from groups whose Safe settings are confirmed
transactions_error_headquarters_only: Only headquarters Owners and Approvers can create payouts
transactions_error_group_no_safe: This group's Safe is not configured yet
transactions_error_amount_decimals: {symbol} amounts can have at most {decimals} decimal places
transactions_error_recipient_invalid: The recipient address is not valid
transactions_error_recipient_zero: Cannot send to the zero address
transactions_error_recipient_self: Cannot send to the paying Safe itself
